title: Gold Rewards Card: No Foreign Transaction Fees - International Purchases Made Easy
summary: Explains the Gold Rewards Card’s foreign transaction fee: Rho‑Bank charges 0% on international purchases. Defines international purchases (in‑person abroad, online with foreign acquirers/payment gateways, and subscriptions billed by international entities) and notes dynamic currency conversion and receipt/dispute guidance.
